versions.content: Alignment of a dynamic DataPrototype The attribute align- ment of SOMEIPTransformationProps defines the padding for alignment purposes that will be added by the SOME/IP transformer after the serialized data of the variable data length data element for which the DataPrototypeTransformationProps is defined according to [TPS_SYST_02121].
